news.comment: Lock completed 14 of 17 passes for 240 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and logged six carries for 20 yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory in Las Vegas.
Shaheed caught one pass for eight yards on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
Barner caught all three targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Raiders.
Metcalf brought in two of six targets for 54 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion catch in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night.
Mayer caught two of three targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks.
Helm caught all four of his targets for 23 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.
Schultz caught one pass for an 11-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.
Gesicki caught one pass for nine yards in Sunday night's 38-18 win over the Steelers.
Warren rushed seven times for 15 yards and brought in five of six targets for 26 yards in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night. He committed a fumble recovered by Pittsburgh.
Spears rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars. He turned one catch into zero yards on one target.
Higgins brought in five of six targets for 66 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.
Davis rushed three times for eight yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.

Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
Burrow completed 35 of 44 passes for 409 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added one rush for eight yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.
Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.
Brown rushed 10 times for 44 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 39 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.
Rodgers completed 15 of 29 passes for 143 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed two times for minus-1 yard during Sunday's 38-18 loss at Cincinnati.
Freiermuth recorded two catches (on three targets) for 35 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-18 loss in Cincinnati.
Coach DeMeco Ryans acknowledged after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns that Marks (concussion) is unlikely to play in Thursday night's game against the Colts, ESPN.com's DJ Bien-Aime reports.

Burks (groin) will not return to Sunday night's game against the Steelers, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
